citations.claim: E approach green at step 105 before yellow
E approach yellow at step 106, first yellow second
E approach still yellow at step 107, second yellow second
E approach red at step 108, yellow lasted only 2s vs required 4s

counterfactual.change: Changed actuated true to false; fixed-time cycle lets yellow run full duration, removing truncation.

explanation: Actuated control ends EW green early when its detectors see no queue while NS has demand (EW queues 0 at steps 105-106, NS queue 14). The early-termination truncates the following EW yellow to 2s (yellow at 106-107, red at 108) instead of required 4s. Fixed-time (actuated false) removes the failure.
vision_note: Two approaches show green at step 105, then turn yellow for steps 106-107, then are already red at step 108. The yellow phase therefore lasts only two seconds before going red instead of the required four.
